chunks: When the oceans surge and swell,

key_terms.سُجِّرَتْ: Were poured with fire / surged / were kindled

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says the seas will be 'sajjirah' (poured with fire/surge)?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (81:6) is often interpreted not merely as a physical transformation but as a profound metaphysical upheaval where the 'seas' symbolize the depths of divine knowledge or the collective consciousness of creation being stirred by God's command. This cosmic sign serves as a precursor to the resurrection, highlighting the absolute sovereignty of Allah in dismantling the existing natural order to prepare for the final reckoning.
